errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slices are ordered by descending size. In the chart, there are two large, equally sized slices (value 2) and two small, equally sized slices (value 1). They are not in descending order.
The description fails to mention the explicit numerical values (1, 2, 2, 1) that are provided in the labels for each slice. This is the primary data shown in the chart.
